# Governance

This document describes how decisions are made in repositories owned by
[@qte77](https://github.com/qte77).

## Status

Single-maintainer project. This document exists to set expectations for
external contributors and to scale the process when additional maintainers
join.

## Roles

- **Maintainer** — merge rights, release authority, final say on disputes.
  Currently: @qte77.
- **Contributor** — anyone submitting issues, PRs, or discussions.

## Decisions

- **Routine PRs** (bug fixes, docs, small features): any maintainer may
  review and merge after CI passes.
- **Breaking changes, new dependencies, scope expansions**: require explicit
  @qte77 approval before merge.
- **Disputes**: @qte77 has final say. Rationale will be documented in the
  relevant PR or issue.

## Releases

- Versioning follows [SemVer](https://semver.org/).
- @qte77 cuts releases. Schedule is as-needed, not time-based.

## Becoming a maintainer

Sustained, high-quality contributions over 6+ months plus a demonstrated
understanding of the project's direction. Invitation is extended by existing
maintainers; there is no application process.

## Amending this document

Open a PR modifying this file. Requires @qte77 approval.
